title: Kerbside idling-scooter exhaust: OpenFOAM LES scenario results (research; agreed statistics of PLAN.md section 5 only)

conventions.stats: P5/P50/P95 over 1,000 emission draws (model.mjs drawScooter) for ONE simulated red per case
conventions.heights: above the standing surface (pavement top 0.2 m)
conventions.K: d = horizontal distance from the nearest kerb-lane tailpipe toward the pavement; dx = along-street offset (-1, 0, +1 m)
conventions.averaging: mean = 90-s red mean; max10s = highest 10-s running mean; max1s = highest 1-s mean

S1.scene: 12 scooters (box 2x4, queue 1x4), wind 0.8 m/s toward -45.0 deg, canyon W=20.0 H=12.0, grade coarse
S1.walltime: mesh 18 s, solve 3,090 s on 3 cores (154k cells, 120 s simulated), post about 2 min
S1.note: baseline dozen, 20 m canyon; A6 failed on the mean (near-ground wind about 0.5 m/s, along the street) | VERIFICATION (PLAN 9.24): end-fed canyon inlet forces 0.6-1.3 m/s along the kerb; K values are kerb-lane pack plume, probably low x2-5; "calm" withdrawn for S2.
S1.conversions: one red adds its 90-s mean / 10 to a 15-min mean and / 40 to a 1-h mean (PLAN 5 item 9)

summary.grade: coarse grade with lean extents (10 cm tailpipe cells on 0.2 m muffler faces, 10 cm kerb-lane bodies, 20 cm over the pack and at the K probes); PLAN 9.18
cases_run: S4 re-weighting of S1, S2, S5-12, S1-from (S4 = S4-S1)
cases_dropped: NF1 single-scooter near field (all sub-runs): budget
S3 behind the last row: not implemented
S6 deep canyon, S9 few, S10 wind from kerb: budget
S7 pull-away, S8 15-min stay-through, S11 underpass: not implemented
G fine-grid repeat (~47 h): grid look is S1-try3 (fast) vs G0-try3 (coarse)
A with 8 reds and uniform directions: one red, one direction

anchor_A2.conditions: one red, wind 1.6 m/s target (2.0 m/s measured at IN, -35 deg) from the pack toward the sensor area; the most favourable direction for a high reading

summary.grid_look: S1-try3 (fast, 5 cm tailpipes) vs G0-try3 (coarse = matrix grade), window 30-64 s: coarse/fast for window means 0.96-1.60 at K 0.5 m, 0.84-2.45 at K 1 m, 0.33-1.02 at K 2 m; highest 1 s 0.29-3.2 at K; near-exit 0.47-0.67. A3 fails: every matrix 1-s and 10-s value, and every 0.5-2 m mean, is grid-limited by about x0.3-3 either way. Heights 0.6 and 0.7 m share one 20 cm cell.
summary.seed: one inflow realisation (seed 20261127) and one red per case; no seed-sensitivity run; A7 not computed. Emission uncertainty: 1,000 draws per case.

acceptance.A6: fails in every case (S1 mean 0.46-0.48 vs 0.8; S2 turbulence floors; A mean 2.0 vs 1.6; S5-12 sigma_w; S1-from sigma_w/U 0.10-0.17 and mean +16-19 %)
acceptance.A8: Courant max 0.8-1.04; domain tracer not steady in A (30-s red), S5-12 (60-s red) and S2 (12 %); S1 and S1-from closest to passing
acceptance.A2: (b) passes for the one red run; (a) not testable
acceptance.A4: fails in every case at 4 m; S1 within x3 at 2 m
